facts.raw_span: 7-year history of a submucosal tumour below the esophagogastric junction
Contrast-enhanced CT of the abdomen revealed a 70 × 50 × 55 mm hypoechogenic, subcardial mass on the posterior gastric wall
endoscopic evaluation demonstrated a recurrent bleeding tumour at the same site
resected endoscopically by a piecemeal technique under general anesthesia

support_spans: 7-year history of a submucosal tumour below the esophagogastric junction
Contrast-enhanced CT of the abdomen revealed a 70 × 50 × 55 mm hypoechogenic, subcardial mass on the posterior gastric wall
histopathology reportedly confirmed a lipoma
contradict_spans: endoscopic evaluation demonstrated a recurrent bleeding tumour at the same site
concepts.why: The patient has a submucosal tumour with a long history, and histopathology confirmed a lipoma, but the tumour recurred after resection.

support_spans: 7-year history of a submucosal tumour below the esophagogastric junction
presented in November 2011 with melena
endoscopic evaluation demonstrated a recurrent bleeding tumour at the same site
concepts.why: The patient has a submucosal tumour with a long history, and presented with melena and a recurrent bleeding tumour, which could be consistent with a GIST.
It explains the low hemoglobin level of 7.5 g/dL.

rationales.F02: Submucosal tumour below the esophagogastric junction is consistent with both gastric lipoma and GIST.
rationales.F04: Melena is a symptom of bleeding, which can be caused by a gastric lipoma or GIST, and also leads to iron deficiency anemia.
rationales.F07: The hypoechogenic mass on the posterior gastric wall is consistent with both gastric lipoma and GIST.
rationales.F08: Histopathology confirmation of a lipoma strongly supports gastric lipoma and rules out GIST.
rationales.F09: Recurrent bleeding tumour at the same site is consistent with both gastric lipoma and GIST, but the previous histopathology result of lipoma makes GIST less likely.

frontier_selector.why: The evidence of a recurrent bleeding tumour at the same site after histopathology reportedly confirmed a lipoma, along with the presentation of melena, decided it.
